name: arxa-artifact-viewer
description: arxa editor owning the stock right column: a tabbed viewer portal-mounted into the frame's rightbar track ([data-rightbar-col]) — every file open (dashboard or conversation) lands in one strip, session-less, with the stock drag handle, renderer dropdown (dsh's MarkdownText included), wrap toggle and persistence. The stock document tab keeps the editor renderer for the not-owning lane. The host half owns the token/write/worktree/LSP routes.
